notes.title: Major Update - Health & Energy No Longer Required
notes.content:
We have released a new update with health and energy no longer required, overall load of the game is improved and others more.

New Major Update - Health & Energy No Longer Required
- Removed the requirement for health/energy. If you go below the health/energy threshold the rewards are lower but you can fight unlimited time, once you have energy/health you fight at higher rewards.
- No more energy needed for Workout and School.
- No more energy needed for Jobs.
- Improved the overall load of the game in many areas.
- Reduced the minimum required resources by the game.

Planet Fights is an online MMO game in which you can have your own virtual life. You can join a nation, buy vehicles, items, properties, open a political party, fight in international battlefields, compete in FPS Alliance Wars, preach in pastors guild, participate in races, take part in special agent fights between agents from other countries, attack other citizens space colonies on any country map, be a nation senator or president, be part of the world congress, vote on nation issues and you can do many other activities.

Hope you will enjoy the new features and see you in the game!

notes.title: Major Update: Country Regions, Corporations, Businesses, New World Map +
notes.content:
We have released an update with country regions added, corporations and businesses in the regions, regions residency, region resources and stats, new world map and more.

Now countries can only be conquered when all regions are conquered for that country. If at least one region is liberated then the country is free again.

Each region has it's own type of resource which affects the production of corporations located in that region.

We also increased the number of active countries needed to support all these and a new world map is waiting for you.

notes.title: Major Update: FPS Alliance Wars
notes.content:
We have released 3D Alliances Shooter Wars in which you fight and shoot your opponents in alliance battles. The FPS comes first on Steam while we may slowly add it to the rest of platforms.

We also reduced number of active countries to 50 since having more than 200 countries with less players in each was not improving competition.

To be able to run all these we moved the in-game client to Unity engine.
